entry.title: Listen for a sound in the room
entry.invitation: Make a familiar sound and notice where their attention goes.
entry.summary: Clap from a different place in the room and notice whether your baby turns or moves toward the sound.
entry.cue: A familiar sound makes your baby look around.
detail: The authors suggest playful sounds from different places, including clapping or a rattle. A clap needs no extra material.
Notice what your baby does, then let their interest guide whether you repeat the game.

references.locator: Sound-location games with clapping and rattles

ageContext.bookAge: 9 to 12 months in the language section.
ageContext.readiness: Noticing a sound and turning or moving toward it.
ageContext.note: The book’s ages are guides; this belongs here only while the described interest and movement fit your child.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
displayContext.colophon: Original summaries inspired by The Montessori Baby and The Montessori Toddler. Open any idea for its book references. The illustration is an invitation to explore, rather than a room to reproduce. Follow your child’s pace.
